samples.question: Each colored socket at the top is a black block with a white opening cut down into it, and the opening has its own depth in each of the five columns. Each black comb below is a peg with five teeth. A peg fits a socket only if it can be pushed straight down into that socket with no tooth running into black, so every tooth must be no longer than the opening in its own column. Give every socket exactly one peg, so that all five pegs are used and each socket takes one. Only one such assignment fits. Which socket gets the peg inside the black ring? Answer blue, green, orange, purple, or red.
